text:
Alex: Going to step off for the 2pm->10pm shift. Handing oncall to Victor. Quick checklist: VPN+KMS, PagerDuty test, runbook link, cluster access. Ping if anything is flaky. /cc @Victor
Victor: Got it, I'm taking it. I'll run through the checks now.
Victor: VPN: confirmed (pulse vpn -> connected to vpc-redwood). GCP: iam role 'redwood-oncall' active. Tested access to model-serving.
Victor: PagerDuty: able to see schedules and incidents. Did a test notification (non-incident) -> acknowledged. :white_check_mark:
Victor: Runbook quick test: opened runbook https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall and scanned playbooks. Noted cached keys section.
Alex: creds reminder: if you see '403 KMS decrypt' try `gcloud auth login` and `gcloud config set project redwood-prod` then `kms decrypt` as below
```
gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=prod-ring --key=redwood-k --ciphertext-file=creds.enc --plaintext-file=creds.json
```
Ravi: If you need PagerDuty CLI: `pd login` then `pd validate` — also check mobile push notifications are enabled on your profile.
Maria: Quick note: the staging telemetry forwarding to splunk is on a rotation tonight (maintenance window 21:00-22:00 UTC). If you see auth errors for telemetry don't panic.
Jamie: Checked observability hooks: tracer agent on model-serving is green, but one worker in us-east1 shows high restart count (see `kubectl get pods -n model-serving`). FYI
Victor: I saw that restart, I checked logs `kubectl logs deployment/encoder -n model-serving --since=10m` and it looked like OOM on a single host. I raised a ticket in #incidents as FYI.
oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall shift change at 14:00. Pager test window scheduled at 14:15.
Victor: I've run a pager test and confirmed push + email. Also validated ssh jump host: `ssh -J ops@jump.redwood.com devops@10.0.4.2` and `kubectl get pods -n model-serving` returns expected.
Alex: Thanks — leaving my screenshares and runbook pointers in the thread. If anything escalates, call me on mobile.
Victor: All good. I'll start the shift. Thx! :v:
